valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (telecomegyptcompany) is served under two keys, EGS48031C016.CA PE 11.31 while ETEL PE is withheld on the issuer's own figures (the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 0.01 against price over EPS 11.32) and the filing does...); one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
